About the USP-S | Blueprint

A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been hand painted using a blue theme to resemble an architect's blueprint. Sometimes the best-laid plans go awry The USP-S | Blueprint is a Mil-Spec-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Blueprint finish on the USP-S. With a Mil-Spec rarity classification, it has approximately a ~15.98% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The USP-S | Blueprint can be unboxed from the Operation Hydra Case. It belongs to the Operation Hydra Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.86. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The USP-S | Blueprint (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $94.53, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $4.79 (Battle-Scarred) to $94.53 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The USP-S | Blueprint has a community rating of 3.2 out of 5 based on 270 votes. This mixed rating suggests the design appeals to some players while others prefer alternative finishes.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the USP-S | Blueprint?

Factory New (FN) USP-S | Blueprint skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Blueprint pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the USP-S | Blueprint a good budget option?

Yes, the USP-S | Blueprint is an excellent budget-friendly choice. Priced affordably, it offers the Blueprint aesthetic without breaking the bank. Budget skins like this are ideal for players building their first inventory or those who prefer spending on multiple skins rather than one expensive item. The lower price point also means less financial risk if you decide to trade or sell later.

What is the float value range for the USP-S | Blueprint?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.86, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the USP-S | Blueprint?

Prices for the USP-S | Blueprint vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Operation Hydra Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the USP-S | Blueprint in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the USP-S | Blueprint are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the USP-S | Blueprint price going up or down?

The USP-S | Blueprint has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the USP-S | Blueprint from?

The USP-S | Blueprint is part of the The Operation Hydra Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Operation Hydra Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the USP-S | Blueprint?

The in-game description reads: "A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been hand painted using a blue theme to resemble an architect's blueprint. Sometimes the best-laid plans go awry" The Blueprint finish on the USP-S is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.

Yes, 1 professional CS2 players currently have the USP-S | Blueprint in their inventory. Pro player adoption is a strong indicator of a skin's prestige and desirability in the community, and can positively influence its market value.
